license: Original Rose meshes and renders; no Fallout assets included.
provenance: Original Rose service, scenery and body meshes rendered in Blender Cycles, with separately authored solid monument meshes baked by the original software 3D rasterizer; both use fixed dimetric projection and the locked v6 indexed palette.

traveler.label: Wayfarer
traveler.description: Lean field layers, a weathered face, swept gray hair, gaiters, a bedroll and a route staff.

archivist.label: Archivist
archivist.description: A long slate coat, narrow shoulders, close cropped hair, a brow lens and a strapped document case.

artisan.label: Artisan
artisan.description: A broad work jacket, a bearded face, leather apron, reinforced boots and a repair harness.

mediator.label: Mediator
mediator.description: A burgundy mantle, shaved head, layered cloth, wrapped forearms and provision satchels.

metal_kin.label: Metal-kin field body
metal_kin.description: A segmented humanoid chassis, ceramic faceplate, exposed joints, utility apron and a restrained seam light.

visual_catalog.scope: Five modeled body families with three palette treatments each. Personal biographies remain authoritative; free text does not synthesize a new mesh. Architecture has four regional models per function and two rendered condition states.
